description: Fetch the financial status for every linked account and record it on the account, with provenance (which version, which customer number, when). PREVIEW BY DEFAULT: nothing is written unless commit=true. The run is logged in import_runs/import_items like every other import, with the last result and the reason for every failure — so the log answers 'when did this last work' without anyone having to remember.

commit.description: true actually writes. Default false = preview.

limit.description: Max accounts per run, default 50, cap 200.

version.description: Sage connector to fetch the financial status from

name: sync_sage_finance
